events.verdict: Jones Jr. (LAC) contests Haliburton's (IND) jump shot attempt and the contact after the release as both players return to the ground is marginal.
Siakam (IND) and Jones Jr.. (LAC) engage and disengage during the inbound and the contact is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Zubac (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Zubac turns and initiates illegal body contact with Mathurin (IND) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) inadvertently dribbles the ball off of his own foot.
Nembhard (IND) reaches in and brushes Harden's (LAC) arm on the perimeter.
Nembhard (IND) legally contests Jones Jr.'s (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Powell (LAC) legally contests Siakam's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) makes contact to Mathurin's (IND) arm, affecting his put-back attempt at the basket.
Nembhard (IND) brushes Harden's (LAC) arm and does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Powell (LAC) commits a take foul on Mathurin (IND).
Siakam (IND) legally contests Powell's (LAC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Dunn (LAC) places his hands on Mathurin (IND) as he reaches for the pass and the contact is marginal.
Mathurin (IND) never has control of the ball when it goes off of his hands and he legally retrieves the loose ball in bounds.
Powell (LAC) reaches in for the ball and makes illegal contact with Mathurin's (IND) left arm, which affects his driving shot attempt in the paint.
Bryant (IND) avoids making any illegal contact with Jones Jr. (LAC) while contesting his driving dunk attempt at the basket.
Mathurin (IND) remains in bounds as he receives the pass.
Mathurin (IND) and Dunn (LAC) briefly engage away from the play and the contact is marginal.
Dunn (LAC) commits a take foul on Haliburton (IND).
Haliburton (IND) legally contests Powell's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
